$comment: MSTool agent registry (REQ-AGT-001; RC-110, RC-111, RC-112, RC-115; HAZ-020).
STATUS: DRAFT, PENDING owner approval. Every agent below is 'pending' or 'planned': the platform refuses to run
any of them until N. G. Bonilla Vargas records 'approved' himself (approval.status, approval.ref).
model use_status is a FACT, not an approval: 'in_use' = what the app calls today; 'candidate' = not re-validated
Tool access: 'read' and 'compute' (computes and returns, stores nothing) may be allowed; 'write' tools are listed
only so that a request for one is refused by name, and a registry that allows one does not validate.
Cost caps and limits are DRAFT values for the owner to decide (Integration_Plan.md, decision D-AGT-3).
Model facts read 2026-11-10 from Anthropic's model pages (deprecations: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires
2026-11-30). Prices are USD per million tokens; re-check them at every re-validation.

Review of PR #79 (2026-11-10): every tool declares its arguments (kind per argument; id-like arguments are resource kinds) — a call with an undeclared or mistyped argument is refused; result_exempt_keys names id-like result keys that are not resources (e.g. a new report id). Switches: an agent runs only when MSTOOL_AGENTS_SWITCH AND its own MSTOOL_AGENT_SWITCH__<ID> read 'on'.
Second review of PR #79 (2026-11-10), superseded by the third review: result ids are no longer decided by key names.

Third review of PR #79 (2026-11-10): a resource id is recognised by its VALUE (UUIDs, DICOM UIDs, prefixed test ids) or by a resource key (segmentation_id, file_id, study_id, ... and the tool's result_resource_keys, taken from the real output schemas: 'id' of compare_longitudinal and list_segmentations); lesion, label, region and zone numbers are not resources; actor keys (created_by, ...) are not scope-checked. Contract tests feed the real outputs of every tool through the check (tests/agent_platform/test_review3.py).

Fifth review of PR #79: every tool declares a typed 'output' schema (resource, actor and exempt fields); an argument is required unless its kind is optional_*; an agent with requires_backend_scope reaches the backend only with the study-scoped capability the backend issued for the run (RC-121).

Sixth review of PR #79: the assistant opens a study session first (open_study_session / open_imaging_session: the backend issues the pass, which never reaches the model); without it every assistant request is refused locally AND by the backend. generate_ms_report is not allowed to the assistant: it calls a paid model outside the agent's cost ledger (RC-112).

Seventh review of PR #79: the session tools take no argument - the physician chooses and confirms the study through the client (MCP elicitation); an agent with tools on the MCP servers must have requires_backend_scope: true (the assistant always needs a scope).

claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.note: the report model on main (config.py CLAUDE_MODEL default); deprecated, retires 2026-11-30

claude-sonnet-5-5.note: current Sonnet; candidate successor, NOT re-validated: refused until the protocol is run and the owner signs

generate_ms_report.server: retired (PR #79 seventh review: a paid model outside the agent's cost ledger; reports are drafted by the verified-report agent, PR #78)

report-drafter.purpose: Draft the comment sentences of the brain MRI report from the device's measurements, for radiologist review (function 1 of the agents plan; PR #78 turns it into the verified report)

approval.ref: agent-platform PR: entry to be approved by the owner

report-drafter.availability: unavailable from 2026-11-30: its only approved model claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires then, and the successor claude-sonnet-5-5 is 'candidate' (not re-validated). Owner decision D-AGT-1 through RVP-AGT-001; the platform never switches models by itself. PR #78's verified report already uses claude-sonnet-5-5: reconcile both when D-AGT-1 is decided.

ms-clinical-assistant.purpose: Read-only assistant over the MCP servers (STDIO, run by the clinician in Claude Desktop / Claude Code): reads stored measurements, compares visits

approval.ref: agent-platform PR: entry to be approved by the owner

quality-gate.purpose: Single quality gate before every AI step and its output: FLAIR, slice thickness, scanner change between visits, skull (function 2; deterministic code, no model, no tool; REQ-FUNC-117, REQ-SAFE-052..054, RC-122..RC-127)

approval.ref: feat/quality-gate (stacked on PR #79): entry to be approved by the owner (D-QG-1)

policy.$comment: No model and no prompt, so no model/prompt card: the gate's card is its policy, bound here by the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (hashing.sha256_text); a policy change without this record fails CI (test_quality_gate_matrix.py, G4).

second-look.purpose: Rank the AI's lesions for 'review first'; never deletes anything (function 3; research now, app in January)

study-questions.purpose: Guided questions to the study answered by the program with citations (function 5); free conversation stays in research until it passes the red-team suite
